samples.text: AccessLUME is not found. It is entered by invitation.LUME is a secret luxury hotel in Monaco built around a different form of exclusivity. Wealth is not the currency. Impact is.01Access to LUME is reserved for people who have positively influenced society and helped others. The invitation is not a purchase, a booking strategy, or a public application. It is recognition.02Once invited, a guest is placed on the list. From that moment, they may request a stay whenever availability allows, but only once per year. When the visit ends, the card resets. The wait becomes part of the experience.03Inside LUME, every object belongs to the stay. Special editions created with the world's most recognised brands exist only within the hotel. They are experienced there, and they remain there.For LUME, contact is not a form. It is the beginning of discretion, consideration, and alignment with a philosophy: the stay itself is the product, and access is earned by what a person contributes to the world.Request informationContinue with the dealership.First nameLast nameEmailPhoneHow can we help?Submit request
